name: Tianji Intelligent
summary:
Tianji Intelligent develops robots, control systems and automation products for industrial and commercial applications. Its portfolio covers several robot configurations in small and medium payload classes, supported by its internally developed Fusion control system.

The company applies these products to production processes in electronics, automotive electronics, new energy, medical equipment, home appliances and food manufacturing. Its offering combines standard robot hardware with application engineering, using process requirements to guide deployment. Research partnerships and testing capabilities support work on robot control, reliability and integration, with an emphasis on improving production quality, efficiency and workplace safety.
